verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both are unusable. Each loses the headline 'We help choosing the right smartphone', the www.hosmart.au URL and the HO SMART wordmark, so the message and brand are gone. The original 728x90 banner is pasted as a thin strip across the middle of a near-square white canvas, leaving about 80% of it empty. The device logo icon floats as a faint white outline on white above the strip, cut off from the blue panel.
